lead.headline: Democrats win House and Senate, ending Republican control of Congress
lead.dek: Seven GOP Senate seats flipped, Maine, Texas and Kansas among them; Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled
body: Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in Tuesday's midterm elections, NBC News and CBS News projected late Tuesday, handing President Trump a Congress run by the opposition party for the final two years of his term. CBS News called the Senate for Democrats at 11:44 p.m. ET.

Democrats flipped seven Republican-held Senate seats — North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Kansas, Iowa and Maine, where Sen. Susan Collins conceded — and held Michigan and Georgia, CBS News reported. Alaska and Mississippi were uncalled as of 4:20 a.m. ET, with about 75 House races undetermined. CBS exit polls put Trump's approval at 38%.

Trump congratulated Democrats in a call with CBS News and said he has "total veto power." House Democrats hold leadership elections the week of Nov. 16, and Rep. Hakeem Jeffries needs 218 votes Jan. 3 to become speaker, NBC News reported. Sen. Chuck Schumer is expected to return as majority leader when the new Congress convenes in January.

briefs.headline: Missouri voters block Republican-drawn congressional map
briefs.summary: NBC News projected the referendum vetoing a GOP map that split Rep. Emanuel Cleaver's Kansas City district. The Supreme Court had barred its use this year.

briefs.headline: Nine governors-elect set firsts, led by Georgia's Bottoms
briefs.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms is the first Black woman elected governor of any state; Deb Haaland is New Mexico's first Native American woman governor, NPR reported.

briefs.headline: Tennessee prison escapee captured in Missouri after 9 days
briefs.summary: Jacob Morley, 28, serving life for a 2022 murder, was arrested near Norborne, Mo., Tuesday, the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said. He escaped Oct. 25.

briefs.headline: New Jersey governor warns ports against Russian diesel
briefs.summary: Gov. Mikie Sherrill told terminal operators in a Nov. 2 letter that Russian diesel would violate a 2022 import ban despite a Treasury license. Diesel averaged $6.29, AAA said.

briefs.headline: Iran calls U.S. reply 'not convincing' as IRGC reports 4 tankers mined
briefs.summary: Mohsen Rezaei called the U.S. answer to Tehran's seven conditions "not convincing" Tuesday; the IRGC said four tankers hit mines in Hormuz Wednesday. Qatar expects feedback within 36 hours, Reuters reported.

briefs.headline: Spain's transport minister resigns after train crash that killed 69
briefs.summary: Oscar Puente quit Tuesday, a week after a Renfe high-speed train hit a stationary Iryo train on the Madrid-Seville line. He said a minister "cannot continue" after two crashes of that severity in a year.

briefs.headline: South Africans vote in local elections seen as test for ANC
briefs.summary: Polls suggest the ANC could fall below 40% in Wednesday's municipal vote for eight metros, 44 districts and 205 local councils. More than 29 million are registered; results are expected Sunday.

briefs.headline: Indonesia's president fires chief of staff over wiretapping
briefs.summary: Prabowo Subianto dismissed Listyo Sigit Prabowo on Wednesday, a day after police arrested the former national police chief over alleged wiretaps of the president and ministers. Two other officers were held.

briefs.headline: Democrats pick up 2 state Senate seats; GOP keeps supermajority
briefs.summary: John Williams unseated Sen. Mike Oliverio and Richie Robb beat appointed Sen. Anne Charnock, MetroNews reported; Republicans keep a supermajority.

briefs.headline: Flanigan, Kirkpatrick beat Morrisey appointees for Supreme Court
briefs.summary: Delegate Bill Flanigan led Justice Thomas Ewing 112,890 to 81,296 with 91% counted when AP called it; retired Judge H.L. Kirkpatrick beat appointee Gerald Titus.

briefs.headline: Voters add citizens-only voting language to state constitution
briefs.summary: MetroNews called Amendment 1 with yes votes ahead by more than 100,000. Noncitizen voting was already illegal by statute; the ban now goes in the constitution.

briefs.headline: Capito wins third U.S. Senate term over Fetty Anderson
briefs.summary: NBC News and AP called the race for the Republican incumbent over Democrat Rachel Fetty Anderson, WSAZ reported, by a tighter margin than her earlier wins.

regional.item: Mason County voters renewed the school excess levy 3,479 to 3,107, keeping the district in line for data center tax revenue.
Democrat Paul Monroe beat Republican Jared Page for the open Kanawha County Commission seat, joining Ben Salango and Natalie Tennant.
Republican Commissioner D. Craig Chapman kept his Nicholas County seat by about 600 votes over Sarah Meadows Brown, state figures showed.
The Summers County schools levy failed by about 150 votes Tuesday; it has not passed in 47 years.

away.item: Bennington voters rejected the 1% local option tax Tuesday, 3,136 to 2,292, and passed a $5 million wastewater bond 3,796 to 1,582.

hotspots.item: Webster County High School marked the 27th annual Lights On Afterschool with a Harry Potter-themed Golden Snitch contest, The Webster Echo reported Sunday.
Pender County voters elected Republicans Shayne Frey and Ryan Collins to the commission's District 1 and 2 seats Tuesday, 56% and 60%, in unofficial results.

briefs.headline: Pedestrian dies in 4:30 a.m. crash at First and Victoria
briefs.summary: Prince George RCMP said a westbound Honda CR-V struck the pedestrian on First Avenue Monday. The driver stayed; police do not believe impairment was a factor.

briefs.headline: Ottawa puts $11M into Conifex sawmill in Mackenzie
briefs.summary: The Regional Tariff Response Initiative money, $10M of it repayable, modernizes five kilns and the planer line. Conifex said the work keeps hundreds of jobs.

briefs.headline: Mother, daughter die in suspected grizzly attack at Bella Coola
briefs.summary: Conservation officers found Jennifer Balcarras, 48, on Monday and Selah Reed, 20, on Tuesday on the Snooka West Trail. Traps are set; no bear has been caught.

briefs.headline: Canada proposes buying 8 German submarines now, 4 later
briefs.summary: CBC News reported, citing three confidential sources, that negotiators offered TKMS a split of the up-to-12-boat order. Germany had promised $86B in economic benefits.

briefs.headline: Carney says U.S. 'asking less and offering more' on trade
briefs.summary: Speaking in Antigua Tuesday, the prime minister said U.S. demands on language, culture and Canada's right to sign other trade deals are off the table.

briefs.headline: George Institute models 3M deaths averted by potassium salt
briefs.summary: A Nature Health study across 193 countries found a full switch to potassium-enriched salt could prevent 2.96 million deaths a year, the institute said.

briefs.headline: KM3NeT finds no break in relativity in 5,828 neutrino events
briefs.summary: The Mediterranean telescope's ORCA detector set new limits on Lorentz invariance violations, including first direct constraints on muon-tau differences, in JCAP.

briefs.headline: Hubble survey finds dwarf galaxies missing most of their oxygen
briefs.summary: A study of 37 nearby dwarf galaxies, published Monday in The Astrophysical Journal, found supernova-driven winds eject far more oxygen than models predict, NASA said.

briefs.headline: Maynooth record shows Irish sea-level rise fastest in a century
briefs.summary: A reconstruction of six tide gauges back to 1925, published in Ocean Science, found the rise accelerating since 2000 to several times the 20th-century average rate.

briefs.headline: Google to switch off classroom AI by default, taking Search too
briefs.summary: Google said K-12 schools will have Gemini, NotebookLM and Gemini in Classroom off unless administrators opt in, and that opting out also removes Google Search.

briefs.headline: Stanford test finds 44% of cited LLM findings no longer hold
briefs.summary: Owen Queen and James Zou tested 50 widely cited claims against 20 models released since July 2024; expired findings lasted 15.7 months on average.

briefs.headline: Apple requires 18+ rating for dating and AI companion apps
briefs.summary: Apple told developers that apps with dating or romantic features, including AI companions, must carry an 18+ rating, with new content descriptors required from Nov. 16.

weather_ear: The weather desk files Wednesday's forecast at 7:15.
kicker: Every West Virginia region carries an election line today; the Kyushu basho (tournament) opens Nov. 8 in Fukuoka, four days out.

art.caption: The Capitol dome against a clear sky, split by a lamp post in the foreground, the morning after Democrats took both chambers.
